canonical_project: Key Point Yekaterinburg data center (industrial park Craft)
notes: Key Point official news (2026-06-30): launched the largest Tier III data center in the Ural Federal District at industrial park Craft near Yekaterinburg; official page lists 880 racks / 6.2 MW, year 2026. Agreement with Sverdlovsk investment agency signed July 2026.
